description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, 2026-10-24), Pod-Simple-3.47 board census.  PRE-EXISTING on main b89b6add.

    my @a = (1,2); my $r = \($a[0]); $$r = 9; print "@a\n";        # perl 9 2   PCL 1 2
    sub f { my $x = \($_[0]); $$x = 7 } my $v = 1; f($v); print "$v\n";   # perl 7   PCL 1
    sub r1 { my $x = ( \( $_[0] ) )[0]; $$x .= "1" }               # TiedOutFH's spelling, same loss
    (`my $x = \$_[0]` -- no parens -- is right: perl 7, PCL 7.)

perl: `\(LIST)` is a list of refs to EACH element of LIST, and `\(ELEM)` with one element is a ref to that element itself (perlref "Making References": "As a special case, \(@foo) returns a list of references to the contents of @foo ... \($x) is the same as \$x").  PCL lowers the parenthesised operand as a VALUE (the element is read, then referenced), so the place is lost.  The fix belongs where the non-parenthesised `\$a[0]` already asks for the element's live box (p-aref-box / p-gethash-box, the argbox for `$_[N]`): the refgen of a parenthesised list must take each element in that same lvalue/box context.  Check `\(@a)` (refs to each element -- the probe printed SCALAR, so the list form may already be handled) and `\(my $x)`.
REACH: Pod-Simple t/tiedfh.t (6 rows); Pod::Simple::TiedOutFH is what output_string uses for a scalar target on some paths.


=== PARTLY DONE (s526w2) ===
FIXED: Pl/ExprToCL.pm gen_prefix_op_form, the single-element `\(ELEM)` branch generates its operand in LVALUE context (as `\ELEM` does) and keeps the magic-lvalue heads; Pl/Parser2.pm _args_elem_written counts `\( $_[0] )` as an argument write (a raw-slot caller otherwise passed its variable by value).  Guard Pl/t/misc-fixes-01.t row 140 (inverse-verified).
OPEN: Pod-Simple t/tiedfh.t still fails 6/6 -- the ref now reaches the caller (an instrumented TiedOutFH copy appends through it: scratch/s526w2/pto2.pl) but the tied handle's PRINT (`$$$it .= $x` on `bless \$scalar_ref`) does not write it back; not reduced (pho2.pl, the same copy chain without the tie, is right).  The rows stay on this task.


=== QUEUED (s530, Fable, 2026-10-31) ===
One of the 41 REAL whole-file CPAN board failures (the USER-asked review; 138 FAIL files = 69 perl-skips + 4 fixed + 2 perl-fails + 22 ruled not-supported + 41 real).  Queued as s531b member 8 (Pod-Simple) -- `briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531a-prompt.md` / `s531b-prompt.md`.
subject: SILENT WRONG: a PARENTHESISED backslash of an ELEMENT -- `\($a[0])`, `\($_[0])`, `(\($_[0]))[0]` -- makes a reference to a COPY: writes through it are lost (`\$a[0]` without parens is right); Pod::Simple::TiedOutFH->handle_on($x) never writes $x (Pod-Simple tiedfh.t 6 rows, and every Pod::Simple output_string-to-a-scalar path through it)
